mode: Production React, CoachService and parser with synthetic replies; muted, no online model calls or LCU writes.

generationTargets.pickAndBanPreference: One primary, one alternate only when useful

verifiedBehaviors: Short conclusions render without extra controls
Long conclusions and composition expose a marked preview and keyboard-accessible full text
Expansion state does not leak into a new analysis
Overlapping notices are grouped while all original warnings remain available
Filtered candidates and missing Mayhem augments remain visibly signaled
Complete-draft estimate label and both sides remain visible
Previously rejected probability and contradictory recommendation replies remain rejected
No horizontal overflow at either supported dock size
limitations: Generation lengths are prompt targets; no live model adherence was measured.
Preview length does not alter the full parsed analysis or its validation.
